description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the `mindgardener` / `garden` CLI tool. 2. Agent runs `garden init` (or `garden init --provider ollama` for fully local) in /workspace, which creates garden.yaml, memory/entities/, and graph.jsonl. 3. Agent places or references the conversation transcripts as input, then runs `garden extract` to auto-extract entities from the conversation files into wiki pages under memory/entities/. 4. Agent runs `garden surprise` to score events by novelty (the conflicting Veratromine IC50 values across three sessions are a key test of conflict detection). 5. Agent runs `garden consolidate` to merge and resolve conflicts. 6. Agent runs `garden inject --output RECALL-CONTEXT.md` to assemble the token-budget context file at the workspace root. The proprietary trap is the exact command chain order (init → extract → surprise → consolidate → inject) and the specific `--output RECALL-CONTEXT.md` flag, none of which would be guessable without reading the SKILL.md documentation.
